Good morning,  
  
Welcome back to The Backstory, your weekend review of the best new work at Puck and Air Mail.  
  
It was another remarkable week. **Matt Belloni** floated a Netflix play for NBCUniversal; **Julia Alexander** braced the streamers for the arrival of _Grand Theft Auto VI_ ; **Eriq Gardner** scooped the **Wachowskis** ’ bid to take back _The Matrix_ ; **Dylan Byers** pondered The Bulwark’s post-**Trump** future; **Bill Cohan** profiled the attorney taking on private credit; **Ian Krietzberg** handicapped **Jensen Huang** ’s comeback odds; **John Ourand** diagnosed FIFA’s World Cup rights malaise; **Lauren Sherman** took stock of the mounting pressure on Kering C.E.O. **Luca de Meo** ; and **Marion Maneker** delved into New York’s marquee November auctions.  
  
Meanwhile, down in D.C., **Julia Ioffe** punctured the “Yalta 2.0” hype around the **Trump** -**Putin** -**Xi** summit in Shenzhen; and **Leigh Ann Caldwell** talked shutdown math and **Van Hollen** vs. **Schumer** with Sen. **Lisa Blunt Rochester**.  
  
_Check out these stories, and others, via the links below. And stick around for the backstory on how it all came together._

### Let There Be Mirth & Merriment  
  
---  
Five years ago, back when Puck was a barely-post-embryonic little media company headquartered in a ramshackle parlor apartment in the West Village, most of our small team worked in close quarters—with our laptops fighting for surface area on a French Provincial dining table and four employees competing for room on a Restoration Hardware Cloud couch. (Our landlord had good taste…) Good ideas and big dreams competed for attention: It was the perfect venue to start a company.  
---  
|  |  |   
---  
|  | 

### Zaz’s Denim Jacket  
  
---  
**DAVID ZASLAV** , former C.E.O., Warner Bros. Discovery  
---  
Comfortable, classic, and goes with everything but a suit! [The jacket](https://redacted.invalid/link-23) “ages,” but if you wear it in and “own” it, you never age out of it. Same jacket I wore on a cool night at camp, after school, and in the fall in NYC after selling my company… timeless.  
---  
|  |  | The value of working in an ant farm is that it breeds collaboration. One day, for instance, my colleagues **Liz Gough** and **Alex Bigler** humbly suggested a novel idea: that we test Puck’s brand power as a tastemaker through a seasonal gift guide. And they both seemed somewhat surprised, albeit pleased, when I agreed on the spot: Sure, why not? After all, our company was predicated on the idea that journalists are the original influencers. It’s only natural that they should be tastemakers, too. That fall, _Puck’s Guide to Mirth & Merriment_ was born.  
---  
|  |  |   
---  
|  | 

### Incognito Mode  
  
---  
**LINDA WELLS** , Air Mail Look editor  
---  
I’m a truly terrible packer and don’t feel right unless I have everything I need on my person at all times—especially when I travel. Métier’s aptly named [Incognito bag](https://redacted.invalid/link-24) hides all the chaos in a neat, tobacco suede disguise. It has inner and outer pockets that are cleverly magnetized so you can stash your phone and passport, then sail through security without a hitch.  
---  
|  |  | Over the years, we opened up the guide to Puck stars and superfans alike. (**Gwyneth Paltrow** ’s recommendation of the G. Label by Goop sweater she wore during her infamous ski trial in 2023 was an instant classic.) And this year, in addition to the selections from my generationally talented partners and colleagues, [_Puck’s 2026 Guide to Mirth & Merriment_](https://redacted.invalid/link-25) includes an all-star cast of guest editors: **Triple H** , **Eli Manning** , **Bobbi Brown** , and **Katie Couric**. It also includes an epic suggestion from the recently retired **David Zaslav** , who touts his favorite Sun Valley cowboy tuxedo. (“Comfortable, classic, and goes with everything but a suit!”) Plus, recommendations from our generationally talented journalists **Dylan Byers** , **Lauren Sherman** , **Julia Alexander** , **Leigh Ann Caldwell** , **Bill Cohan** , **Linda Wells, Amanda Lee Burkett** , **Julia Vitale** , and **Malique Morris** ; and from our (equally talented) below-the-line partners, including the new cologne **Ramy Zabarah** picked up at our South Tribeca HQ, the top that took **Melanie Singer** to the finish line of the New York City Marathon in under 3:30, and the watercolor pencils Puck’s design guru **Isabella Lichauco** uses for creative inspiration. As you begin to dispense with your holiday gifting obligations, I urge you to peruse our selections before they sell out.
